content.title: Ultimate Guide to TGL Season 2: Everything You Need to Know
content.text: Every hit on the big Screen deserves a sequel. It’s time for Season 2 of TGL presented by SoFi.That means all six teams are back for a full slate ahead of the postseason, culminating in the best-of-three Finals Series for the right to hoist the SoFi Cup.The 2025 season provided a crash-course in fast-paced, tech-infused team golf, leading to a series of unforgettable moments and thrilling competition. The action will once again take place at SoFi Center on the campus of Palm Beach State College, where every player will be mic’d up for the duration of every match.RELATED: TGL ExplainedSeason 2 will include a few enhancements and upgrades inside the arena, along with familiar TGL mainstays like the Hammer and owners cheering on every shot from their boxes.First up – a rematch of last year’s Finals with defending-champion Atlanta Drive GC taking on New York Golf Club. Can the Drive make a serious repeat bid? Will New York return stronger and determined to take the Cup? Or will we see a team that finished near the bottom of the SoFi Cup Standings emerge as a championship threat?With a new year on the horizon, let’s take a look at the teams, the format, and what’s new for Season 2.WHEN DOES TGL SEASON 2 START?A new season at SoFi Center begins at 3 p.m. ET Sunday, December 28th, with Atlanta and New York going head-to-head live on ABC. That’s followed by a primetime clash with Boston Common Golf taking on Los Angeles Golf Club at 7 p.m. ET Jan. 2.The rest of the regular season will feature near-weekly matches on Mondays and Tuesdays, culminating in the final regular-season match between The Bay Golf Club and Jupiter Golf Links on March 3.Sights & Sounds of SoFi CenterFans who want to see the action up close can purchase tickets for every match directly through Ticketmaster, while at-home viewing options include live broadcasts on ABC, ESPN and ESPN 2, along with live streaming on the ESPN app.TICKET INFO: Everything You Need to Know about TGL TicketsHOW MANY MATCHES ARE IN A TGL SEASON?TGL 2026 will feature 15 regular-season matches, with each team playing all five opponents once ahead of the postseason.The Season 2 playoffs begin with a Semifinals doubleheader on March 17 – the first match tees off at 6:30 p.m. ET, followed by the second Semifinal at 9 p.m. at SoFi Center.TGL’s Finals Series is a best-of-three format, with Match 1 taking place at 9 p.m. ET March 23. Match 2 is slated for 7 p.m. March 24, followed by a third and decisive match at 9 p.m. if necessary.HOW DO I WATCH TGL?TGL will air live throughout the United States on ABC, ESPN and ESPN 2, while viewers can also tune in on livestream via the ESPN App. Golf fans around the world can also catch every match on our International partner networks.RELATED: How to Watch TGL in Your CountryTHE TEAMSATLANTA DRIVE GCThe Roster: Patrick Cantlay, Lucas Glover, Billy Horschel, Justin ThomasSeason 1 Recap: Atlanta looked the part all season long, routinely showing up to SoFi Center with Atlanta Falcons jerseys, Dirty Bird chains and wild dance moves. They backed it up with their play, losing just one regular-season match to earn the No. 3 seed in the postseason. After topping The Bay Golf Club in the Semifinals, Atlanta won the first two Finals matches to sweep New York and become the first-ever SoFi Cup champion.Hot Mic: Best of Atlanta Drive GC Season 1FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on Atlanta Drive GCBOSTON COMMON GOLFThe Roster: Keegan Bradley, Hideki Matsuyama, Rory McIlroy, Adam ScottSeason 1 Recap: Boston made an unforgettable SoFi Center debut in an Overtime thriller, coming up just short against Jupiter Links Golf Club. That was the story of the season, with Boston finishing 0-4-1. The Ballfrogs fought hard to the end throughout several close losses and look poised to make a big leap entering TGL Season 2.Hot Mic: Best of Boston Common Golf Season 1FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on Boston Common GolfJUPITER LINKS GOLF CLUBThe Roster: Max Homa, Tom Kim, Kevin Kisner, Tiger WoodsSeason 1 Recap: Jupiter was creating viral moments before the first swing of the club, with Tiger Woods & crew making an unforgettable entrance to the playing area at SoFi Center ahead of their season opener against Los Angeles. An enusing overtime win over Boston in primetime had Jupiter poised to make a postseason run. While Jupiter ultimately fell just outside the playoff bubble, few if any teams had more fun and created more memorable moments.Hot Mic: Best of Jupiter Links GC Season 1FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on Jupiter Links Golf ClubLOS ANGELES GOLF CLUBThe Roster: Tommy Fleetwood, Collin Morikawa, Justin Rose, Sahith TheegalaSeason 1 Recap: Los Angeles was the class of the league throughout the regular season, earning the No. 1 overall seed with a 4-0-1 record. It came to an abrupt end following a 6-4 Semifinals loss to New York, and Los Angeles enters TGL 2026 with plenty of unfinished business.Hot Mic: Best of Los Angeles Golf Club Season 1 FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on Los Angeles Golf ClubNEW YORK GOLF CLUBThe Roster: Matt Fitzpatrick, Rickie Fowler, Xander Schauffele, Cameron YoungSeason 1 Recap: New York got off to a rough start, getting outscored 13-2 in back-to-back losses to The Bay and Atlanta. With very little room for error the rest of the way, NYGC got to work, putting lights out while winning two of their three final matches to earn the fourth and final playoff spot. New York then upset top-seeded Los Angeles to secure a Finals bid, where they lost two-straight matches by one point against Atlanta. NYGC should enter Season 2 with plenty of confidence, as resilience is clearly one of its biggest strengths.Hot Mic: Best of New York Golf Club Season 1FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on New York Golf ClubTHE BAY GOLF CLUBThe Roster: Ludvig Åberg, Wyndham Clark, Min Woo Lee, Shane LowrySeason 1 Recap: While not considered a Season 1 favorite by most, The Bay proved they belong at the top with a 4-1 regular-season record. Clark was one of the league’s most prolific scorers all season, but all four players combined to create one of the most versatile squads in the league. One thing’s for sure – The Bay won’t be sneaking up on anyone this season after coming up short in a Semifinals tilt with Atlanta.Hot Mic: Best of The Bay Golf Club Season 1FULL TEAM PREVIEW: Dive Deeper on The Bay Golf ClubWhile Season 2 will feature the original six teams, TGL is set to welcome another squad with the addition of Motor City Golf Club representing Detroit in 2027.RELATED: Take the Quiz to Find Out Which Team You Should Root ForKEY DATESSeason 2 of TGL begins with a Dec. 28 Finals Series rematch as Atlanta and New York run it back for the opener on ABC.A Jan. 6 Semifinals rematch between Atlanta and The Bay kicks off a stretch of six consecutive weeks with TGL matches on Monday or Tuesday night.The action returns with a Feb. 23 TGL Doubleheader, as Atlanta takes on Boston in the first match and Los Angeles in the nightcap.Another Sunday night tilt is set for March 1 in a rematch of one of the most memorable matches from 2025, when league co-founders Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy went heads up as Jupiter scored an overtime win over Boston.The top four teams in the league will compete in a Semifinals doubleheader March 17, followed by the Finals Series March 23-24.THE FORMATMatch Format Explained: Triples & SinglesEvery TGL match is a 15-hole competition featuring nine holes of Triples and six holes of Singles. Triples is alternate shot format with all three players taking turns, while Singles is standard one-on-one. Match play scoring is in effect with each hole worth one point to start, though stakes can increase via the Hammer.Teams start every match with three Hammers to use at any point. Throwing the Hammer increases the stakes of the hole by one point if accepted, but opponents can choose to decline and forfeit the hole to lose just one point.The top four teams in the regular season make the playoffs, with number of holes won throughout the year serving as the tiebreaker. Two Semifinals matches are then followed by a best-of-three Finals Series at SoFi Center.SEASON 1 RECAP: KEY MOMENTS AND STATSWith New York looking to force a third and decisive match against Atlanta in the Finals Series, Billy Horschel sunk what would prove to be the winning 17-foot birdie putt as Atlanta captured the SoFi Cup last March.Billy Flips The Match, 'This Is My House!'That moment capped a season filled with memorable performances, including:A league-high 13 Singles points for Horschel across the regular season and playoffs360-yard drives from Wyndham Clark, Ludvig Åberg and Cameron YoungWyndham Clark logging 26 points in the regular season across Triples and Singles, seven more than the next leading scorerTop ball speed of 193.0 MPH from Min Woo LeeJupiter’s 4-3 Overtime win over Boston on Jan. 27Los Angeles erasing a 4-0 deficit through 11 holes for a 5-4 Overtime win over New York on Feb. 24New York returning the favor in a 6-4 Semifinals upset win over top-seeded Los AngelesWHAT’S NEW IN SEASON 2?Several changes and improvements have been made entering TGL Season 2, including a new-look GreenZone. TGL has expanded the putting surface and the bunkers based on feedback and data from Season 1, while also adding more pin locations and creating more undulation on the putting surface. In addition, several areas of the GreenZone have been lowered to create better sightlines for fans at SoFi Center.GreenZone Renovation: Fast FactsSeason 2 also sees the debut of Team Holes, each of them uniquely designed and themed for teams to play in their matches.RELATED: Check out all hole designs for Season 2All holes will see updated graphics with sharper imaging as well, with several brand new holes debuting from golf architects Gil Hanse, Agustin Piza and Beau Welling.
